Name: Night Owl
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Lets you stay up a full 24 hours instead of collapsing at 2am, including a morning light transition as the sun rises.

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.0 or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*][i](optional)[/i] Merge the mod's [font=Courier New]Content[/font] folder into you game's [font=Courier New]Content[/font] folder to enable night fishing.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
Simply stay up past 2am, and you won't collapse. The lighting will gradually brighten as the sun rises. At 6am you'll temporarily collapse so the game can save, but you won't lose anything and you'll stay where you are.

Edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file in a text editor to change the mod settings (it will appear after you run the game once).

[size=5]Mod Authors:
[/size]If you want to make your mod compatible with Night Owl and want to do some custom logic I have added in an API documented [url=http://https://github.com/janavarro95/Stardew_Valley_Mods/blob/SMAPI3.0/GeneralMods/NightOwl/Framework/NightOwlAPI.cs]here[/url]﻿ which allows you to add custom logic after the player has stayed up until 6:00 AM and after Night Owl handles re-warping the player to their pre-collapse position. Please consult the Stardew Modding API mod API documentation page for how to access this api.

Thanks!

[size=5]Config Notes:
[/size]As of the 1.7 update this mod uses an internal AssetEditor to modify the Fish.xnb file, removing the need for the optional file NightFish. However, for compatibility sakes with other fishing mods, the old NightFish file is still supported so that it may be edited to be in use with other fishing mods. To use a custom Fish.xnb instead of the mod's internal code one, just set UseInternalNightFishAssetEditor to false in the mod's config.

Thanks!
